subject: Quick details for Saturday's picnic
text:
Hi,

I wanted to send over the quick details for Saturday's community picnic before the plans scatter. We're meeting at the park entrance near the fountain, then walking to the covered tables by the playground. We've got the big blue canopy with us, so look for that if you want the fastest way to find us.

Start time is 11, and it'll be casual, with people arriving as they can. Volunteers will have name tags, but you'll mostly just need to be friendly and keep an eye on the craft table. There's going to be snacks, probably too many cookies, and a short cleanup around 3 if everyone is up for it.

The one catch is that I may arrive a little late because I promised to help move boxes for the neighbor first. If that happens, please don't wait for me at the gate. Just check in with the coordinator or anyone wearing the volunteer lanyard, and they'll sort you in. I hate conflicting with plans, especially yours, so let me know if Saturday feels too tight for you. Otherwise, I'm genuinely looking forward to seeing you there. If you want to bring a folding chair, that would help, and I'll leave a message at the main table with the exact setup number once we get there. Also, if rain threatens, we'll shift indoors to the library hall and I'll text you first. I'm hoping the weather holds, but it would still be fun either way.
